
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19998021" title="发布于 2026-05-10 16:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript中一个很有意思的语法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持解析执行和编译执行2种模式，其中有个语法很有意思，那就是static语法。</p>
<p>在解析执行模式下，static语句与非static语句是等效的；</p>
<p>在编译执行模式下，static语句会在编译期间执行，也就是说static语句不会被编译，而是直接执行并返回结果。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>示例</p>
</blockquote>
<p>我们来看一个示例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static int n = 10; // 直接执行，不参与编译
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static x = n * 2; // 直接执行，不参与编译
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int y = static n * 2; // 编译结果：y = 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/*
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int m=20;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int a = static m * 2; // 报错：variable m is not exists
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*/
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int z = n * 2; // 编译结果：z = n * 2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x+y+z;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 编译</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> func = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, script.Context.EvalVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>, script.Context.EvalVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.IsNull(script.Context.EvalVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> Assert.IsNull(script.Context.EvalVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">z</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>, func());</pre>
</div>
<p>static语句中的变量必须是在static语句中定义的，由于变量n、x是在static语句中定义的，脚本执行前就已经计算出结果了，上面示例编译结果为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> y = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> z = n * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> x+y+z;</pre>
</div>
<p>那么基于static语法的特性，我们可以在哪些场景中使用呢？</p>
<blockquote>
<p>场景一：eval函数</p>
</blockquote>
<p>在之前一篇文章<a title="AScript之eval函数详解" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19967057" target="_blank">《AScript之eval函数详解》</a>中介绍过eval函数的功能和运行机制。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> n=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n+20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> eval(s); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果为20</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如上示例在编译执行模式下计算结果并不是我们预期的30，我们使用static语法试试：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> n=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n+20</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> eval(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> s); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 结果为30</span></pre>
</div>
<p>结果是预期的30了，我们可以在static语句中对字符串进行拼接处理，然后给到eval来执行。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>场景二：编译委托</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    min+=10;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    max+=5;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n &gt;= min &amp;&amp; n &lt;= max
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">min</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">max</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> func = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(s, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> total = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10000</span>; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (func(i)) total++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">26</span>, total);</pre>
</div>
<p>我们可以利用static语法的特性，在脚本中做一些初始化逻辑，比如从数据库中获取配置等。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>实现原理</p>
</blockquote>
<p>最后我们来看看static语法是如何实现的吧？</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StaticTokenHandler : ITokenHandler
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> StaticTokenHandler Instance = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StaticTokenHandler();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (e.TreeBuilder.IsFullStatement())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             e.End = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TokenReader.Push(e.CurrentToken);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> options =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.Options;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果当前为编译模式，则改为使用执行模式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> ((options.CompileMode?? ECompileMode.None) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ECompileMode.All)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>             options = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BuildOptions(e.Options) { CompileMode =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ECompileMode.None };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> node = analyzer.BuildOneStatement2(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, options, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, noblock: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (node != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行并返回结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v = node.Eval(e.ScriptContext, options, e.Control, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.TreeBuilder.AddData(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, PoolManage.CreateObjectNode(v, type));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>然后在CSharpLang中注册：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AddTokenHandler(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, StaticTokenHandler.Instance);</span>&nbsp;，几行代码就实现了一个有意思语法。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>说点什么</p>
</blockquote>
<p>还有一个@lang/@end语法也是比较有意思，脚本中可以嵌入其他语言。</p>
<p>最后，AScript是一个灵活、成长性强的脚本引擎，你可以用它来实现自己的想法，大家如果有想到什么好玩的功能不妨试试！</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>AScript开源地址：https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</p>

</div>
